gaps.source: ALEF data/morning-verses.json, Deuteronomy 30:14 (pointed Hebrew from existing project corpus; English: JPS 1917, public domain; external source collation pending).
gaps.production: Israeli woman he-IL-Chirp3-HD-Kore and man he-IL-Chirp3-HD-Charon, rate 1, this exact pointed text. This is a verse, not a complete prayer.

gaps.he: וַאֲהַבְתֶּם אֶת־הַגֵּר כִּי־גֵרִים הֱיִיתֶם בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃
gaps.en: Love ye therefore the stranger; for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.
gaps.source: ALEF data/morning-verses.json, Deuteronomy 10:19 (pointed Hebrew from existing project corpus; English: JPS 1917, public domain; external source collation pending).
